module: Auxiliary anti-lag (ALS) controller for a turbocharged engine. State machine off / idle / armed / manualOverride / timeout: in idle it arms after a few seconds of full throttle at high RPM; when armed, when the vehicle is moving, the throttle is lifted (or the brake pressed) and the engine runs fast enough, it uses a PID to drive the engine's anti-lag coefficient (engine:setAntilagCoef) to keep the turbo at turboTargetRPM. A maximum continuous time prevents overheating. Publishes electrics.values.alsActive (boolean) and alsState (string).
usage:
local als = controller.getController("antiLag")
als.setAntilagState("manualOverride") -- forced anti-lag (coef = 1)
als.setAntilagState("off")
notes: jbeam keys read: controlledEngine ("mainEngine"), turboTargetRPM (90000), minActiveEngineRPM (2000), minActiveWheelSpeed (1 m/s), maxActiveThrottleInput (0.2), minActiveBrakeInput (0.2), timeoutTime (30 s), timeoutResetTime (2 s), autoArmMinRPM (5000), autoArmMinThrottle (0.5), autoArmTime (1 s), autoDisarmMaxRPM (3000), autoDisarmMaxThrottle (0.3), autoDisarmTime (3 s).
Valid states for setAntilagState: "off", "idle", "armed", "manualOverride", "timeout" (no validation: any value is accepted as is).
Without an engine or if the engine has no turbocharger (engine.turbocharger), log E and updateGFX becomes nop.
The timeout accumulates when the anti-lag is active and decreases 3 times faster otherwise.
reset always sets the state back to idle even if the previous mode was off, and does not reset the arming/disarming timers.
getState/setState expose a remote mode: "off", "automatic" (idle/armed/timeout) or "manualOverride" (key <controller name>_mode).

init.desc: Gets the engine and its turbocharger, reads the jbeam thresholds and creates the turbo RPM PID.

reset.desc: Resets timeout, PID and state (idle) to zero and the alsActive/alsState electrics.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: advances the state machine and applies the anti-lag coefficient to the engine.

setAntilagState.desc: Forces the internal state of the state machine (off, idle, armed, manualOverride, timeout).

getState.desc: Saveable state: remote mode (off / automatic / manualOverride).

setState.desc: Restores the mode from the table (unknown modes ignored).
